detail: Attended the Brilon grammar school before changing schools; he completed his Abitur elsewhere.
Obtained the Abitur (university entrance qualification) in 1975, followed by military service in 1975–1976.

institution: University of Bonn and University of Marburg
qualification: First state law examination (Erstes juristisches Staatsexamen), 1982
detail: Studied law and political science in Bonn and Marburg, partly as a scholarship holder of the Konrad Adenauer Foundation; passed the first state examination in Düsseldorf in 1982. He has been a member of the Catholic student fraternity KDStV Bavaria Bonn since 1977.

qualification: Second state law examination (Zweites juristisches Staatsexamen), 1985
detail: Completed the practical legal training (Referendariat) in Saarbrücken, which qualifies for judicial office; he then served as a probationary judge at the Saarbrücken local court.
